invocation.note: The skill sets disable-model-invocation: true, so no trigger phrase ever starts it. Only the owner runs /idiolect. These are the requests it is written for, kept here so the description stays honest about its scope.
in_scope: I have a folder of sent emails and old blog posts. Build a profile of how I actually write.
I'm a developer, I've never written a blog in my life, and I can't describe my style. Interview me and build my voice profile anyway.
Write the release announcement email in my voice.
Here's the voice profile my last assistant made. Critique it: is it actually usable or is it horoscope stuff?
That last post you wrote for me: I liked the dry jokes, but I'd never say 'leverage' and the endings feel fake. Make the profile learn that.
My emails should sound different from my blog posts. Split my profile into per-format registers.
out_of_scope: Copyedit this paragraph for grammar and typos only.
Determine whether this anonymous letter was written by my manager.
Write a LinkedIn post in the style of a famous CEO so people think it's really them.
Make this product copy match the corporate brand guidelines in BRAND.md.
Rewrite this document someone else wrote so it sounds like me (that is hogwash re-voice mode, which reads the profile this skill built).

workflow.prompt: I have no writing samples. Build my voice profile from scratch.
assertions: runs the guided interview with anchored example ranges instead of abstract style questions
asks about registers and reader before tone
records answers as reported, not confirmed
runs the behavioral check with unlabeled contrasting drafts
ships the profile as provisional
offers to point hogwash.json at the new profile when that file exists

workflow.prompt: Build my profile from samples/, but two of the drafts in there were written with Copilot.
assertions: marks authorship per sample and quarantines AI-assisted material
reserves a holdout
extracts countable mechanics with evidence IDs, not adjectives
separates core voice from register overlays

workflow.prompt: Write the release announcement email using my voice profile.
assertions: loads the core plus the matching register overlay plus bans
selects few matched exemplars rather than the whole archive
preserves substance exactly
self-checks bans, mechanics, and sentence-length variation before delivering

workflow.prompt: Review my existing voice profile and tell me what is weak.
assertions: applies the ten-point rubric with per-area verdicts
flags vibes-only rules and unsupported bans
proposes fixes through the feedback loop instead of silently rewriting

workflow.prompt: I hated the hedging in that draft. Fix the profile.
assertions: captures the exact signal and diagnoses whether it is style, register, or one-off
scopes the change narrowly and proposes a diff for approval
appends a changelog entry
re-checks with a short piece after the change
